cues.text: A business is made of thousands of moving parts.
Every system knows something. None of them knows the business.
So someone has to connect it all. Usually, that someone is the owner. The owner is the API.
But what if your business had a brain?
One intelligence, shaped by the business itself.
You don't learn the software. It learns your business.
A conversation becomes a rule. A rule becomes capability.
Not separate systems. Different organs. One mind.
Every correction adds knowledge. Every experience becomes memory.
Software can be replaced. Shared history is different.
At some point it is no longer a generic system. It becomes yours.
The business grows it. And it grows the business.
What happens when the business itself begins to learn?
One business. One memory. One language. One mind. One evolving entity.
